_help: A subclass. 'classId' is the class it belongs to (barbarian, bard, cleric, druid, fighter, monk, paladin, ranger, rogue, sorcerer, warlock, wizard). 'level' on each feature is the CLASS level. Always-prepared spells use 'minLevel' (class level).

subclasses.name: Oath of the Hearth
subclasses.summary: Guardians of homes and the people in them
subclasses.description: Paladins who swear to protect the hearth: villages, families and travelers seeking shelter.

features.name: Hearth Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: level 3 Sanctuary, Shield of Faith; level 5 Aid; level 9 Protection from Energy.

features._help: A feature with a pick-one choice. Each option can carry its own effects.
features.name: Hearth Vow

features._help: A feature with limited uses. 'max' can be a number, "pb" (Proficiency Bonus) or {"ability": "cha"}. 'reset' is short or long.
features.name: Hearthward
features.description: As a Reaction when an ally within 10 feet is hit, you reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Charisma modifier.
